summary: A choice-only pattern reveals every tested default-bank answer, including all five surviving batch questions and ten stored generated questions.

Integrate the x and y factors.
Absorb constant factors into C and select the equivalent implicit equation.

decision_variation.details: Within every sampled easy family, the keyed equation is identifiable from the fixed R, -R, 2R choice structure without examining the ODE. Publication filtering preserves this bypass. Actual learner policy/history was unavailable; no exact live mixture is certified.

findings.description: The default bank offers keyed L=R+C alongside L=-R+C and L=2R+C. Choose the equation whose right side has both its negative and double represented with the same left side. This answers every tested default question without separation or integration, including all five surviving batch items.
findings.reproduction: From evidence_root run: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python reproduce-shortcut.py. It exits 1 and saves minimal-failure.json. Minimal call: generate_easy(seed=101, template="exp_linear", parameters={"h":0,"k":0}). The keyed e^y=x^2+C is exposed by the co-offered negative and doubled right sides.
findings.requested_change: Change the family-wide default bank construction so its sign/scale relationships do not reveal the key. Vary eligible correct coefficient/sign roles while preserving the source method, retain the strict reproduction test, and rebuild the five-item batch. affected-inventory.json identifies ten demonstrated stored generated instances with complete matching replays in generated-records.json; preserve original source questions.
